en: The four Uposatha days of the Mahāyāna are the eighth day of the second month, the eighth day of the fourth month, the eighth day of the fifth month, and the fifteenth day of the seventh month.
The three months of the Long Fast throughout the year are the first, fifth, and ninth months. The six Uposatha days are the eighth, tenth, [fourteenth, fifteenth, eighteenth, and twenty-third].
On the fourth, fifteenth, twenty-third, twenty-eighth, and thirtieth days of the month—
the ten *zhāi* (fasting) days—
the child Kiao, who observes good and evil, descends to take note.
On the fourteenth day, Chaming Silu descends;
on the fifteenth day, the Great Deity of the Five Paths descends;
on the eighteenth day, King Yama descends.
On the twenty-third day, the Celestial Great General descends.
On the twenty-fourth day, Śakra descends.
On the twenty-eighth day, the Army of Mount Tai descends.
On the twenty-ninth day, the Four Heavenly Kings descend;
on the thirtieth day, the Celestial Bureau and the Earthly Halls descend;

on the first day, the Youth descends. By reciting [the name of] Tathāgata Dīpaṃkara, one eliminates the obstacles of the fast and purges sins, so that for forty kalpas one shall not fall into the hell of swords and spears.

On the eighth day, the Deity of the Lower Realm of Contemplation, Yaoshiliuliangfo (Bhaiṣajyaguruvaiḍūryaprabha), descends; by reciting his name, one eliminates transgressions and is spared from falling into the Powdered-Earth Hell for thirty kalpas.

On the fourteenth day, Chamingshen (the Deity Who Examines Life) descends; by reciting the names of the thousand Buddhas of the Bhadrakalpa, one eliminates transgressions and is spared from falling into the Cauldron-and-Broth Hell for one thousand kalpas.

On the fifteenth day, the Great General of the Five Paths descends; by reciting the name of Amitābha Buddha, one expiates transgressions and is exempted from falling into the Cold Ice Hell for two hundred kalpas.
On the eighteenth day, King Yama descends; by reciting the name of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, one expiates transgressions and is exempted from falling into the Sword-Tree Hell for ninety kalpas.

On the twenty-third day, the Great Heavenly General descends; by reciting the name of Vairocana Buddha, one eliminates the transgressions of a fast and shall not fall into the realms of hungry ghosts or hell for a thousand kalpas.

On the twenty-fourth day, the Lord of Mount Tai descends; by reciting the name of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva, one eliminates the transgressions of a fast and shall not fall into the Hell of Severing Limbs for ninety kalpas.
On the twenty-eighth day, Śakra, Lord of Devas, descends; by recollecting Amitābha Buddha, one eliminates the transgressions of a fast and shall not fall into the Iron Saw Hell for a thousand kalpas.

On the twenty-ninth day, the Four Heavenly Kings descend; by recollecting the Bodhisattvas Bhaiṣajyarāja and Bhaiṣajyasamudgata, one eliminates the transgressions of a fast and shall not fall into the Grinding Mill Hell for seven thousand kalpas.
On the thirtieth day, Mahābrahmā descended and called upon Śākyamuni Buddha to remove his fast-breaking and his transgressions; for eight thousand kalpas he shall not fall into the Cold Ice Hell.
